title: My Name is Fred (Collage)
description:
A slightly absurdist collage of several discrete images photobashed and composited together. Centered around the mid-late 90s, I incorporated popular 90s anime iconography, classic operating system GUI design, and real futurism art from the time period, and employed posterization and noise filters to emulate limited-color screen dithering.
For what it's worth, my name isn't Fred.

title: Quantize
description: A vaporwave aesthetic-inspired scene, which I constructed entirely from scratch purely using Photoshop. No external resources were used in the making of the project, and all three-dimensional work was done using perspective warping tools by hand.

title: Spatial
description: Fictitious video editing company I created over the span of two weeks. I built a design language around the idea of a spatially-oriented editing product and designed a series of logos and wordmarks for the project that I later used on a showcase website.

title: Personal Brand
description: I fully redesigned my personal logo, wordmark, color palette, and typography in early 2025 to build a cohesive brand identity, which I have since incorporated throughout both this website and my other online media.

title: Faithful Resource Pack
description: Worked with the Faithful Resource Pack staff team to refresh their branding throughout late 2024 and early 2025 by modernizing their logo set, naming scheme, and website design.
Quick drawing for a friend, based on their real-life cat. Intended for use as a profile picture at small scales.
title: Cat Profile
TV Profile
description: Profile picture for a user with a computer-themed online avatar. Designed several prototypes over the course of a few months, with each iteration focusing on eliminating unnecessary detail and ensuring maximum legibility at small scales despite the relatively low contrast of the reference design.

title: Lettered Profile
description: Monogram modelled around high fashion logos and overlapping type. I intended it for use as a profile picture, but it can also function as a wordmark or banner by modifying the proportions.

title: Skull Profile
description: Commission for a chef-themed skull avatar. I hand-animated each frame to build a seamless GIF loop using Aseprite, and used procedural image manipulation techniques to generate a dynamic rainbow effect.

title: Cat Renders
description: Commission for a series of custom cat textures to match the client's real-life pet. I built an initial model and design in a low resolution and upscaled it in two iterations to both 2x and 4x the original resolution, respectively.

title: Zombie Texture
description: Commission for a hand-upscaled zombie texture based on low-resolution reference work.

title: Computer Avatar
description: Commission to rework a client's existing avatar to follow pixel art convention and overall modernize its design.

title: Dragon Avatar
description: Commission to translate a client's existing original character into a video game avatar, stylizing the design in the process to match convention.

title: Character Avatar
description: Remake of an old avatar of mine to follow pixel art convention and improve the color dynamics.
